summary: The count, "Select all N", the bulk actions and "Clear selection", shown above a table while any of its rows is selected. Pair it with useTableSelection.
useWhen: a table's rows can be selected and acted on together — pause, export, delete
the rows are paged, and an action may need to reach every row that matches, not just the page on screen

useInstead.when: there are actions but no row selection
useInstead.why: the bar exists to say how many are selected and to act on them; without a selection it has nothing to count

useInstead.when: an action applies to one row
useInstead.why: put it in that row's own actions menu; ticking a box to act on one row is two steps where one would do

composition.note: Hold the selection in `useTableSelection({ total })`: spread its `count`, `isAllMatching`, `selectAllMatching` and `clear` onto the bar, `headSelection(pageKeys)` onto the head TableRow's `selection`, and `rowSelection(key, label)` plus `isSelected(key)` onto each body row. Render the bar always — it hides itself at zero — and give the Table an `id` passed as `tableId`. Call `clear()` whenever the filters, the sort or the page size change. When `selection.mode` is `all`, send the server "every row matching these filters, except `selection.except`".
composition.example: <TableBatchBar count={sel.count} total={total} isAllMatching={sel.isAllMatching} onSelectAll={sel.selectAllMatching} onClear={sel.clear} tableId="agents"><Button size="sm" variant="secondary">Pause</Button><Button size="sm" variant="destructive">Delete</Button></TableBatchBar>

children.note: the bulk actions; placed in a Toolbar named for the count

labels.note: every string the bar renders — selected, allSelected, selectAll, clear, actions — for translation. Each receives its number already formatted for the locale

a11y.role: status for the count; toolbar for the actions
guarantees: the count is a `role="status"` live region that is in the page before the first selection, so "1 selected" is announced rather than inserted silently
the actions are a Toolbar: one tab stop, arrow keys between them, named "Actions for N selected rows"
"Clear selection" returns focus to the table's select-all checkbox (with `tableId`), since the bar and the button pressed go away with the selection
numbers are formatted with `Intl.NumberFormat` in the user's locale
requires: an `id` on the Table, passed as `tableId`, so focus has somewhere to go on clear
the selection checkboxes labelled — `headSelection` and `rowSelection` take the label
notes: The header checkbox selects the page you can see. Rows you cannot see are the bar's separate "Select all N" press, offered once fewer than all are selected — a bulk delete must never reach thousands of unseen rows from one tick.

antiPatterns.dont: mounting the bar only once something is selected
antiPatterns.why: a live region inserted with its first message is silent in most screen readers — the first tick goes unannounced

antiPatterns.dont: a header checkbox that selects every matching row
antiPatterns.why: one tick reaching rows nobody has seen is how a bulk delete removes data by surprise

antiPatterns.dont: keeping the selection across a filter or sort change
antiPatterns.why: the ticked rows may no longer be on screen, and the bar would act on rows the user can no longer see

antiPatterns.dont: a destructive bulk action with no confirmation
antiPatterns.do: the DestructiveConfirm pattern, naming the count
antiPatterns.why: "Delete 128" after one press of Select all is one click from removing everything the filter matched
